name: Rustic Montana Furniture
old_description: Your source for authentic, elegantly western furniture.  Made in Montana, you can be assured each piece is created to last a lifetime.  All of our beds are true mortise and tenon construction.   Transform your home with handcrafted authentic western beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, and benches.  Created from barnwood or log, each are handcrafted with form and function in mind.  Our dining tables are all one-of-a-kind created with reclaimed lumber.  For your outdoor space we have rustic swings for two.  Rustic Montana Furniture is certified “Made in Montana”.
about:
Rustic Montana Furniture operates from Philipsburg, Montana, where it has been producing handcrafted western furniture for over two decades. The business is run by Walter Stanghill, who serves as the primary contact for the company. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the firm emphasizes its long-standing presence in the state and its commitment to local manufacturing.

The company designs and builds a range of solid-wood pieces including beds, end tables, console tables, dressers, chests, vanities, dining tables, benches, and outdoor swings. Every bed uses true mortise-and-tenon joinery, and dining tables are made from one-of-a-kind reclaimed lumber. Production is described as entirely handcrafted, with custom design services offered alongside standard product lines. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The firm markets directly to homeowners seeking authentic western aesthetics, positioning its work as heirloom-quality furniture for residential spaces. The website does not list specific commercial clients, interior-design accounts, or wholesale channels, so the primary customer base appears to be individual consumers.

Rustic Montana Furniture highlights its "Made in Montana" certification and its use of traditional mortise-and-tenon construction as key differentiators. The emphasis on reclaimed barnwood and log materials, along with the promise that each dining table is unique, frames the brand around authenticity and durability rather than mass production.
